record.context_brief: Covering radius of a tensor-product dual repetition code
record.original_question: If R_m denotes the binary repetition code of length m, what is the covering radius of the dual code (R_m ⊗ R_m)^⊥?

evidence.quote: Let Rm denote the binary repetition code of length m.
Open Question 12.8. What is the covering radius of (Rm ⊗ Rm)⊥?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $R_m \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^m$ denote the binary repetition code of length $m$, i.e. $R_m=\{(0,0,\dots,0),(1,1,\dots,1)\}$. For two binary linear codes $A\subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^a$ and $B\subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^b$, define their tensor product $A\otimes B \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^{a\times b}$ to be the linear code consisting of all $a\times b$ binary matrices whose every column lies in $A$ and whose every row lies in $B$ (equivalently, the $\mathbb{F}_2$-linear span of the rank-one matrices $u v^\top$ with $u\in A$, $v\in B$). Identifying $\mathbb{F}_2^{m\times m}$ with $\mathbb{F}_2^{m^2}$ via the standard inner product $\langle X,Y\rangle = \sum_{i,j} X_{ij}Y_{ij}$, let $(R_m\otimes R_m)^{\perp} \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^{m^2}$ denote the dual code of $R_m\otimes R_m$. The covering radius of a code $C\subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ is $\rho(C) = \max_{x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n} \min_{c\in C} d_H(x,c)$, where $d_H$ is the Hamming distance. Determine, as a function of $m$, the covering radius $\rho\big((R_m\otimes R_m)^{\perp}\big)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches for the covering radius of the dual of the tensor product of two binary repetition codes did not return any specific resolution. General references on covering radii of repetition codes and on tensor-product code constructions exist, but none of the located sources state the value of $\rho((R_m\otimes R_m)^\perp)$ for general $m$, so the current status could not be verified.
